questions.text: mens-cal-001 a rectangle is 8 cm long and 5 cm wide. find its area. 一個長方形長 8 cm、闊 5 cm。求它的面積。 eac original practice eac 原創練習 rectangle area · 長方形面積
mens-cal-002 a circle has radius 7 cm. find its area in terms of π. 一個圓的半徑為 7 cm。以 π 表示它的面積。 eac original practice eac 原創練習 circle area · 圓面積
mens-cal-003 a prism has cross-sectional area 12 cm2 and length 5 cm. find its volume. 一個柱體的截面積為 12 cm2,長為 5 cm。求體積。 eac original practice eac 原創練習 prism volume · 柱體體積
mens-cal-004 a cylinder has radius 3 cm and height 8 cm. find its volume. 一個圓柱的半徑為 3 cm,高為 8 cm。求體積。 eac original practice eac 原創練習 cylinder volume · 圓柱體積
mens-cal-005 find the total surface area of a closed cylinder of radius 3 cm and height 5 cm. 一個密封圓柱的半徑為 3 cm,高為 5 cm。求總表面積。 eac original practice eac 原創練習 cylinder surface area · 圓柱表面面積
mens-cal-006 two similar solids have corresponding lengths in the ratio 2 : 3. find their volume ratio. 兩個相似立體的對應邊長之比為 2 : 3。求體積之比。 eac original practice eac 原創練習 volume ratio · 體積比
mens-cal-007 a sector has radius 6 cm and angle 120°. find its area. 一個扇形的半徑為 6 cm,圓心角為 120°。求面積。 eac original practice eac 原創練習 sector area · 扇形面積
mens-sa-001 a rectangle is 12 cm long and 7 cm wide. find its area in cm2. enter only the number. 長方形長 12 cm、闊 7 cm。求面積(cm2),只需輸入數值。 eac original practice eac 原創練習 rectangle area · 長方形面積
mens-sa-002 a prism has cross-sectional area 18 cm2 and length 7 cm. find its volume in cm3. 柱體截面積為 18 cm2,長 7 cm。求體積(cm3)。 eac original practice eac 原創練習 prism volume · 柱體體積

mens-str-001 a closed cylinder has radius 4 cm and height 9 cm. (a) find its volume. (b) find its total surface area. give exact answers in terms of π. 一個密封圓柱半徑為 4 cm,高為 9 cm。(a) 求體積;(b) 求總表面積,以 π 表示答案。 eac original practice eac 原創練習 cylinder surface area · 圓柱表面面積

mens-long-001 two similar closed cylinders a and b have radii in the ratio 2:3. a has radius 4 cm and height 10 cm. (a) find the radius and height of b. (b) find both volumes. (c) find the ratio of their total surface areas. explain each scale factor. 兩個相似密封圓柱 a、b 的半徑比為 2:3。a 的半徑為 4 cm,高為 10 cm。(a) 求 b 的半徑及高;(b) 求兩者體積;(c) 求總表面積之比,並解釋各比例因子。 eac original practice eac 原創練習 volume ratio · 體積比
mens-diag-001 the figure shows rectangle abcd. ab=8 cm and bc=6 cm. find the area of triangle abc. 圖中 abcd 為長方形,ab=8 cm、bc=6 cm。求三角形 abc 的面積。 eac original practice eac 原創練習 rectangle area · 長方形面積

import-mensuration-mens-m002 in the figure, the solid consists of a right circular cone and a hemisphere with a common base. the base radius and the height of the circular cone are \(3\text{ cm}\) and \(4\text{ cm}\) respectively. find the total surface area of the solid. 圖中,該立體由一個直立圓錐及一個共享底面的半球組成。圓錐的底半徑及高分別為 \(3\text{ cm}\) 及 \(4\text{ cm}\)。求該立體的總表面積。 mensuration mc 2 來源所列(未獨立核實):mensuration mc 2 count exposed faces and curved surfaces / 分辨外露平面與曲面

import-mensuration-mens-m003 if the height of a regular tetrahedron is \(2\text{ cm}\), then the volume of the tetrahedron is 若一個正四面體的高為 \(2\text{ cm}\),則該四面體的體積為 mensuration mc 3 來源所列(未獨立核實):mensuration mc 3 use the appropriate volume formula / 單一立體體積

import-mensuration-mens-m004 in the figure, the base of a right prism is a right-angled triangle with legs 6 cm and 8 cm. the length of the prism is 10 cm. find the volume of the prism. 圖中所示為一個直立棱柱,底面為一直角三角形,兩股分別為 6 cm 及 8 cm。棱柱的長度為 10 cm。求該棱柱的體積。 mensuration mc 4 來源所列(未獨立核實):mensuration mc 4 use the appropriate volume formula / 單一立體體積

import-mensuration-mens-m006 the base radius of a right circular cone is 2 times the base radius of a right circular cylinder while the height of the circular cylinder is 3 times the height of the circular cone. if the volume of the circular cone is \(36\pi\text{ cm}^3\), then the volume of the circular cylinder is 一個直立圓錐的底半徑為一個直立圓柱底半徑的 2 倍,而圓柱的高為圓錐高的 3 倍。若圓柱的體積為 \(243\pi\text{ cm}^3\),則圓錐的體積為 mensuration mc 6 來源所列(未獨立核實):mensuration mc 6 length, area and volume scale powers / 長度面積體積比例

import-mensuration-mens-m007 in the figure, the base of a solid right triangular prism is a right-angled triangle with legs 8 cm and 15 cm. the length of the prism is 10 cm. find the volume of the prism. 圖中,該實心直立三角棱柱的底面為一直角三角形,兩股分別為 8 cm 及 15 cm。棱柱的長度為 10 cm。求該棱柱的體積。 mensuration mc 7 來源所列(未獨立核實):mensuration mc 7 use the appropriate volume formula / 單一立體體積

import-mensuration-mens-m008 the base of a solid right pyramid is a square of side \(18\text{ cm}\). if the height of the pyramid is \(12\text{ cm}\), then the total surface area of the pyramid is 一個實心直立錐體的底面為邊長 \(18\text{ cm}\) 的正方形。若錐體高 \(12\text{ cm}\),則錐體的總表面積為 mensuration mc 8 來源所列(未獨立核實):mensuration mc 8 count exposed faces and curved surfaces / 分辨外露平面與曲面

import-mensuration-mens-m009 if the volume of a right circular cylinder of base radius \(5a\text{ cm}\) and height \(7b\text{ cm}\) is \(525\text{ cm}^3\), then the volume of a right circular cone of base radius \(7a\text{ cm}\) and height \(5b\text{ cm}\) is 若一個底半徑 \(5a\text{ cm}\)、高 \(7b\text{ cm}\) 的直立圓柱體積為 \(525\text{ cm}^3\),則一個底半徑 \(7a\text{ cm}\)、高 \(5b\text{ cm}\) 的直立圓錐體積為 mensuration mc 9 來源所列(未獨立核實):mensuration mc 9 use the appropriate volume formula / 單一立體體積

import-mensuration-mens-m010 the base of a solid right prism is a regular 6-sided polygon of side 8 cm. if the volume of the prism is \(288\text{ cm}^3\), find the total surface area of the prism correct to the nearest \(\text{cm}^2\). 一個實心直立棱柱的底面為邊長 \(8\) cm 的正六邊形。若棱柱的體積為 \(288\text{ cm}^3\),求棱柱的總表面積,準確至最接近的 \(\text{cm}^2\)。 mensuration mc 10 來源所列(未獨立核實):mensuration mc 10 count exposed faces and curved surfaces / 分辨外露平面與曲面

import-mensuration-mens-m011 the sum of the total surface areas of two solid hemispheres is \(351\pi\text{ cm}^2\). if the ratio of the radius of the smaller hemisphere to the radius of the larger hemisphere is \(2:3\), then the difference of the volumes of the two hemispheres is 兩個實心半球的總表面積和為 \(351\pi\text{ cm}^2\)。若較小半球與較大半球的半徑比為 \(2:3\),則兩半球的體積差為 mensuration mc 11 來源所列(未獨立核實):mensuration mc 11 length, area and volume scale powers / 長度面積體積比例

import-mensuration-mens-m012 the radius of a solid hemisphere and the base radius of a solid right circular cylinder are equal. if the height of the circular cylinder is equal to its base diameter, then the ratio of the total surface area of the hemisphere to the total surface area of the circular cylinder is 一個實心半球的半徑與一個實心直立圓柱的底半徑相等。若圓柱的高等於其底直徑,則半球與圓柱的總表面積之比為 mensuration mc 12 來源所列(未獨立核實):mensuration mc 12 count exposed faces and curved surfaces / 分辨外露平面與曲面

import-mensuration-mens-m013 the diameter of a circle is 10 cm. the circle is divided into a major segment and a minor segment by a chord of length 8 cm. find the area of the major segment correct to the nearest \(\text{cm}^2\). 一個圓的直徑為 \(10\) cm。該圓被一條長 \(8\) cm 的弦分成一個大弓形及一個小弓形。求大弓形的面積,準確至最接近的 \(\text{cm}^2\)。 mensuration mc 13 來源所列(未獨立核實):mensuration mc 13 sector angle, arc and area / 扇形角弧長與面積

import-mensuration-mens-m014 the length of a side of a solid cube is 60 cm. the volume of a solid right circular cylinder is equal to the volume of the cube while the curved surface area of the circular cylinder is equal to the total surface area of the cube. find the base radius of the circular cylinder. 一個實心立方體的邊長為 \(60\) cm。一個實心直立圓柱的體積等於立方體的體積,而圓柱的曲面面積等於立方體的總表面積。求圓柱的底半徑。 mensuration mc 14 來源所列(未獨立核實):mensuration mc 14 count exposed faces and curved surfaces / 分辨外露平面與曲面

import-mensuration-mens-m016 if the arc length and the area of a sector are \(8\pi\text{ cm}\) and \(80\pi\text{ cm}^2\) respectively, then the angle of the sector is 若一個扇形的弧長及面積分別為 \(8\pi\text{ cm}\) 及 \(80\pi\text{ cm}^2\),則扇形的角為 mensuration mc 16 來源所列(未獨立核實):mensuration mc 16 sector angle, arc and area / 扇形角弧長與面積

import-mensuration-mens-m017 the ratio of the height of a right circular cylinder to the height of a right circular cone is \(32:15\) while the ratio of the volume of the circular cylinder to the volume of the circular cone is \(10:9\). if the base radius of the circular cylinder is 25 cm, then the base radius of the circular cone is 一個直立圓柱的高與一個直立圓錐的高之比為 \(32:15\),而圓柱體積與圓錐體積之比為 \(10:9\)。若圓柱的底半徑為 \(8\) cm,則圓錐的底半徑為 mensuration mc 17 來源所列(未獨立核實):mensuration mc 17 length, area and volume scale powers / 長度面積體積比例

import-mensuration-mens-m018 the perimeter of the sector \(omn\) is \(12\pi\) cm, where \(o\) is the centre of the sector \(omn\). if the radius of the sector \(omn\) is \(3\pi\) cm, which of the following are true? 扇形 \(omn\) 的周界為 \(12\pi\) cm,其中 \(o\) 為扇形 \(omn\) 的圓心。若扇形 \(omn\) 的半徑為 \(3\pi\) cm,下列哪項必為正確? mensuration mc 18 來源所列(未獨立核實):mensuration mc 18 sector angle, arc and area / 扇形角弧長與面積

import-mensuration-mens-m019 the height and the total surface area of a solid right circular cylinder are 35 cm and \(492\pi\text{ cm}^2\) respectively. if the radius of a solid sphere is equal to the base radius of the circular cylinder, then the volume of the sphere is 一個實心直立圓柱的高及總表面積分別為 \(35\) cm 及 \(492\pi\text{ cm}^2\)。若一個實心球的半徑等於圓柱的底半徑,則球的體積為 mensuration mc 19 來源所列(未獨立核實):mensuration mc 19 count exposed faces and curved surfaces / 分辨外露平面與曲面

import-mensuration-mens-m020 the perimeter and the area of a sector are \(k\) cm and \(3k\) cm\(^2\) respectively. if the radius of the sector is 14 cm, then the arc length of the sector is 一個扇形的周界及面積分別為 \(k\) cm 及 \(3k\text{ cm}^2\)。若扇形的半徑為 \(14\) cm,則扇形的弧長為 mensuration mc 20 來源所列(未獨立核實):mensuration mc 20 sector angle, arc and area / 扇形角弧長與面積

import-mensuration-mens-m021 the base of a solid right pyramid is a regular 6-sided polygon of side 6 cm. if the total surface area of the pyramid is \(396\text{ cm}^2\), find the volume of the pyramid correct to the nearest \(\text{cm}^3\). 一個實心直立錐體的底面為邊長 \(6\) cm 的正六邊形。若錐體的總表面積為 \(396\text{ cm}^2\),求錐體的體積,準確至最接近的 \(\text{cm}^3\)。 mensuration mc 21 來源所列(未獨立核實):mensuration mc 21 count exposed faces and curved surfaces / 分辨外露平面與曲面

import-mensuration-mens-m023 the radius of a solid sphere and the base radius of a solid right circular cylinder are equal. if the ratio of the height of the circular cylinder to its base radius is 2 : 3, then the ratio of the surface area of the sphere to the total surface area of the circular cylinder is 一個實心球的半徑與一個實心直立圓柱的底半徑相等。若圓柱的高與底半徑之比為 \(2:3\),則球的表面積與圓柱總表面積之比為 mensuration mc 23 來源所列(未獨立核實):mensuration mc 23 count exposed faces and curved surfaces / 分辨外露平面與曲面

import-mensuration-mens-m024 the base radius of a right circular cylinder is r , and the base radius of a right circular cone is r . if the volume of the circular cylinder is 9 times that of the circular cone and the two solids have the same height, then r : r = 一個直立圓柱的底半徑為 \(r\),一個直立圓錐的底半徑為 \(r\)。若圓柱體積為圓錐的 \(9\) 倍,且兩立體高度相同,則 \(r:r=\) mensuration mc 24 來源所列(未獨立核實):mensuration mc 24 use the appropriate volume formula / 單一立體體積

import-mensuration-mens-m026 the base radius of a solid right circular cone is 16 cm. if the total surface area of the cone is \(800\pi\text{ cm}^2\), then the volume of the cone is 一個實心直立圓錐的底半徑為 \(16\) cm。若圓錐的總表面積為 \(800\pi\text{ cm}^2\),則圓錐的體積為 mensuration mc 26 來源所列(未獨立核實):mensuration mc 26 count exposed faces and curved surfaces / 分辨外露平面與曲面

import-mensuration-mens-m027 if the volume of a sphere of radius \(r\text{ cm}\) is \(2304\pi\text{ cm}^3\), then the volume of a right circular cone of base radius \(r\text{ cm}\) and height 8 cm is 若一個半徑 \(r\) cm 的球體積為 \(2304\pi\text{ cm}^3\),則一個底半徑 \(r\) cm、高 \(8\) cm 的直立圓錐體積為 mensuration mc 27 來源所列(未獨立核實):mensuration mc 27 use the appropriate volume formula / 單一立體體積

import-mensuration-mens-m028 the base radius of a right circular cylinder is 3 times the base radius of a right circular cone while the volume of the circular cone is 2 times the volume of the circular cylinder. find the ratio of the height of the circular cylinder to the height of the circular cone. 一個直立圓柱的底半徑為一個直立圓錐底半徑的 \(3\) 倍,而圓錐體積為圓柱的 \(2\) 倍。求圓柱的高與圓錐的高之比。 mensuration mc 28 來源所列(未獨立核實):mensuration mc 28 use the appropriate volume formula / 單一立體體積

import-mensuration-mens-m030 the radius of a solid hemisphere is half of the base radius of a solid right circular cone. if the height of the circular cone is equal to the diameter of the solid hemisphere, then the ratio of the volume of the solid hemisphere to the volume of the circular cone is 一個實心半球的半徑為一個實心直立圓錐底半徑的一半。若圓錐的高等於實心半球的直徑,則實心半球與實心圓錐的體積比為 mensuration mc 30 來源所列(未獨立核實):mensuration mc 30 length, area and volume scale powers / 長度面積體積比例

import-mensuration-mens-m031 the angle and the arc length of a paper sector are θo and 16π cm respectively. the paper sector is folded into a right circular conical vessel. if the curved surface area of the vessel is 640 cm2, find θ. 一個紙製扇形的角及弧長分別為 \(\theta^\circ\) 及 \(16\pi\) cm。該紙扇形被摺成一個直立圓錐形容器。若容器的曲面面積為 \(640\text{ cm}^2\),求 \(\theta\)。 mensuration mc 31 來源所列(未獨立核實):mensuration mc 31 count exposed faces and curved surfaces / 分辨外露平面與曲面

import-mensuration-mens-m032 the sum of the volumes of a hemisphere and a sphere is 8 928π cm3 . if the surface area of the sphere is 3 times the total surface area of the hemisphere, then the radius of the hemisphere is 一個半球與一個球的體積和為 \(8928\pi\text{ cm}^3\)。若球的表面積為半球總表面積的 \(3\) 倍,則半球的半徑為 mensuration mc 32 來源所列(未獨立核實):mensuration mc 32 count exposed faces and curved surfaces / 分辨外露平面與曲面

import-mensuration-mens-m033 the radius of a solid hemisphere is 18 cm. the volume of the hemisphere is 4 times the volume of a solid right circular cylinder while the total surface area of the hemisphere is 3 times the curved surface area of the circular cylinder. find the base radius of the circular cylinder. 一個實心半球的半徑為 \(18\) cm。半球體積為一個實心直立圓柱體積的 \(4\) 倍,而半球的總表面積為圓柱曲面面積的 \(3\) 倍。求圓柱的底半徑。 mensuration mc 33 來源所列(未獨立核實):mensuration mc 33 count exposed faces and curved surfaces / 分辨外露平面與曲面

import-mensuration-mens-m034 the base radius and the height of a right circular cylinder are 4 cm and 6 cm respectively. the perimeter of the base of a right circular cone is \(12 \pi \mathrm{~cm}\). if the volume of the circular cylinder and the volume of the circular cone are the same, the slant height of the circular cone is 一直立圓柱的底半徑及高分別為 4 cm 及 6 cm。一直立圓錐的底周界為 \(12\pi\) cm。若兩者體積相等,求圓錐的斜高。 mensuration mc 34 來源所列(未獨立核實):mensuration mc 34 use the appropriate volume formula / 單一立體體積

import-mensuration-mens-m035 suppose that the angles of two sectors are equal, and the radius of the larger sector is equal to three times the radius of the smaller sector. if the difference of the arc lengths of the two sectors is \(4\pi\text{ cm}\) and the difference of the areas of the two sectors is \(20\pi\text{ cm}^2\), then the angle of one of the sectors is 兩扇形的圓心角相等,較大扇形的半徑是較小扇形的 3 倍。兩扇形的弧長差為 \(4\pi\) cm,面積差為 \(20\pi\text{ cm}^2\)。求每個扇形的圓心角。 mensuration mc 35 來源所列(未獨立核實):mensuration mc 35 sector angle, arc and area / 扇形角弧長與面積

import-mensuration-mens-m038 if the curved surface area of a right circular cylinder of base radius 2a cm and height 6a cm is 624 cm2 , then the total surface area of a solid hemisphere of radius 5a cm is 若一個底半徑 \(2a\) cm、高 \(6a\) cm 的直立圓柱曲面面積為 \(624\text{ cm}^2\),則一個半徑 \(5a\) cm 的實心半球總表面積為 mensuration mc 38 來源所列(未獨立核實):mensuration mc 38 count exposed faces and curved surfaces / 分辨外露平面與曲面

import-mensuration-mens-m040 a and b are two solid hemispheres. the diameter of b is greater than the diameter of a by 24 cm. if the difference of the total surface areas of a and b is 864π cm2, find the volume of b. \(a\) 及 \(b\) 為兩個實心半球。\(b\) 的直徑比 \(a\) 的直徑大 \(24\) cm。若 \(a\) 與 \(b\) 的總表面積差為 \(864\pi\text{ cm}^2\),求 \(b\) 的體積。 mensuration mc 40 來源所列(未獨立核實):mensuration mc 40 count exposed faces and curved surfaces / 分辨外露平面與曲面

import-mensuration-mens-m041 the height of a solid right circular cylinder is equal to the height of a solid right circular cone. the base radius of the circular cylinder is twice the base radius of the circular cone while the volume of the circular cylinder is \(600 \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\). find the volume of the circular cone. 一個實心直立圓柱的高等於一個實心直立圓錐的高。圓柱的底半徑為圓錐底半徑的兩倍,而圓柱體積為 \(600\text{ cm}^3\)。求圓錐的體積。 mensuration mc 41 來源所列(未獨立核實):mensuration mc 41 use the appropriate volume formula / 單一立體體積

import-mensuration-mens-m042 the radius of a solid sphere and the base radius of a solid right circular cylinder are equal. if the ratio of the height of the circular cylinder to its base radius is \(3:5\), then the ratio of the surface area of the sphere to the total surface area of the circular cylinder is 一個實心球的半徑與一個實心直立圓柱的底半徑相等。若圓柱的高與底半徑之比為 \(3:5\),則球的表面積與圓柱總表面積之比為 mensuration mc 42 來源所列(未獨立核實):mensuration mc 42 count exposed faces and curved surfaces / 分辨外露平面與曲面
